title: Daily 5, Mon 23 Nov
sourceNote: Original questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 5 questions, 10 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Everyone gets the same five. The ranking is by marks, then by time.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, rupee sign or units.

questions.text: What is the sum of all real x with |x − 5| = 3?
A invests ₹3,000 for 8 months and B invests ₹5,000 for 6 months. They share a profit of ₹1,800. How much does A get?
The selling price of 12 pens equals the cost price of 15 pens. What is the profit percentage?
A boat has a still-water speed of 8 km/h and the stream runs at 2 km/h. How long does it take to go 30 km upstream?
How many pairs of positive integers (x, y) satisfy 2x + 3y = 25?
